Which of the following is the correct symbolic notation for the sentence given below?

*"The function $f$ maps the set of real numbers to the set $Y.$"*

feedback.problem:
Which of the following is the correct symbolic notation for the sentence given below?

*"The function $g$ maps the set of rational numbers to the set of real numbers."*
feedback.worked_solution:
The sentence *"The function $g$ maps the set of rational numbers to the set of real numbers"* is equivalent to the following symbolic notation:

$\,$ $g:Q\to R$

Here, the domain of $g$ is $Q,$ and the codomain of $g$ is $R.$
